articles.headline: Nvidia customers warned of AI server price hikes as memory costs surge
articles.summary: Some of Nvidia’s largest customers have been told that prices for servers using its AI chips will rise by more than 15% in many cases. For businesses planning AI infrastructure, this points to higher capex and tighter budgeting as memory inflation filters through the server market.

articles.headline: UK cyber agency tells organisations to keep AI kill switches ready
articles.summary: The UK’s NCSC advised organisations running AI agents to retain the ability to shut systems down entirely if incidents occur. For enterprises, this strengthens the case for operational controls, incident response planning and governance around agentic AI deployments.

articles.headline: Alibaba profit falls 75% after ramping up AI infrastructure spending
articles.summary: Alibaba’s sharp profit decline highlights how aggressively major platforms are spending on AI infrastructure. For business leaders, it is a warning that competitive pressure in AI can compress margins while pushing cloud and compute investment higher across the sector.
